facts.fact: The Namibian reports that the City of Windhoek bills water accounts for named customers in its Solar billing system, with payments and arrears recorded against each account; a February 2024 internal memo found accounts imported from the financial system with wrong customer information, and a payment history missing from one account.

The Namibian reports the City of Windhoek's billing system Solar runs on the city's own servers, with the vendor BCX supplying the financial management software; no reporting to a national system is stated.
The Namibian's report covers only the City of Windhoek's billing system; no other local authority is mentioned.

The Namibian reports on 2 July 2024 that the City of Windhoek confirmed irregularities in its water billing system, with forensic investigators appointed and nine accounts found with wrong figures; the system keeps logs for only 30 days.

systems.platform: Solar financial system; BCX financial management software
systems.tiers: City of Windhoek: water billing and customer accounts
